posts.post: if you spend ten minutes staring at your closet only to wear the exact same thing as yesterday, we’re the same person.
everyone claims to love thrifting but most of us just hate paying retail. let’s be real.
stop pretending you actually like the feeling of starched collars. we all just want to live in soft fabrics.
the most stylish people i know all have that one item they refuse to throw away despite it falling apart at the seams.
